metadata.author: Chico

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Use a column based layout instead of the default row. This makes it easier to arrange the commands.
ast.target: 使用欄式版面取代預設的列式版面，讓命令更容易排列。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Change the height of each button inside the mobile toolbar (in px).
ast.target: 變更行動工具列中每個按鈕的高度（單位為 px）。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Change the width of each button inside the mobile toolbar (in px).
ast.target: 變更行動工具列中每個按鈕的寬度（單位為 px）。

ast.name: setTooltip
ast.source: Reset to default - requires a restart
ast.target: 還原預設值 - 需要重新啟動

ast.name: Notice
ast.source: If the default icon doesn't appear, you might have to restart Obsidian.
ast.target: 如果預設圖示沒有出現，你可能需要重新啟動 Obsidian。

ast.name: description
ast.source: Show the "Add Command" Button in every Menu.
ast.target: 在每個選單中顯示「新增命令」按鈕。

regex.source: The Toolbar is only available in Obsidian Mobile.
regex.target: 工具列僅可在 Obsidian 行動版使用。

regex.source: As of Obsidian 1.1.0 you can reorder the Buttons in the left ribbon by dragging. This will replace the old sorting feature.
regex.target: 從 Obsidian 1.1.0 起，你可以拖曳左側功能區中的按鈕來重新排列。此功能將取代舊有的排序功能。

regex.source: When clicking on a Command in the Explorer, the Explorer view will become focused. This might interfere with Commands that are supposed to be executed on an active File/Explorer.
regex.target: 在檔案總管中點選命令時，焦點會移至檔案總管檢視。這可能會干擾原本應在作用中檔案或檔案總管上執行的命令。

regex.source: To configure which Commands show up in the Toolbar, open the Mobile Settings.
regex.target: 若要設定工具列中顯示哪些命令，請開啟行動版設定。

regex.source: desc:"Set how many rows the mobile toolbar should have. Set this to 0 to remove the toolbar."
regex.target: desc:"設定行動工具列的列數。設為 0 可移除工具列。"

regex.source: desc:"Offset the toolbar from the bottom of the screen. This is useful if the toolbar is partially obscured by other UI elements."
regex.target: desc:"設定工具列與畫面底部的偏移距離。當工具列部分被其他介面元素遮住時，此設定很有用。"

regex.source: desc:"Some themes need extra spacing in the toolbar. If your toolbar doesn't wrap properly, try increasing this value."
regex.target: desc:"某些佈景主題需要增加工具列間距。若工具列無法正確換行，請嘗試提高此數值。"
